processes.rationale: Cloud-storage sync. Spikes disk I/O and CPU on file change bursts. Suspend; resume on profile exit and sync catches up.
OneDrive's per-file co-authoring helper. Spawns alongside OneDrive.exe and shares its sync burden. Suspend with OneDrive itself.
Same pattern as OneDrive. Suspend-friendly.
Same pattern as OneDrive.

processes.display_name: Google Drive for desktop (FS driver helper)
processes.rationale: User-mode helper for Drive's stream-files mount. Suspends cleanly alongside the main sync process.
Cloud-storage sync. Same I/O pattern as OneDrive/Dropbox.
MEGA cloud sync. Heavy crypto + I/O during background transfers.
Box cloud sync. Same I/O profile as other sync clients.
Peripheral RGB / DPI control. Known for DPC latency spikes from frequent USB polling. Suspending pauses RGB but doesn't crash anything.

processes.display_name: ASUS Aura / Armoury Crate Lighting Service
processes.rationale: ASUS RGB service. Same DPC-spike pattern as iCUE.
ASUS umbrella service. Heavier than just lighting; well-known DPC offender.

processes.display_name: ASUS Armoury Crate User Session Helper
processes.rationale: Per-user helper for Armoury Crate. Suspending alongside the main service stops the full Armoury stack for the session.
ASUS background optimisations / hotkey handler. Periodic polling; suspend with the rest of the ASUS stack.
Razer device service. RGB + telemetry; same pattern as iCUE.
Razer Synapse UI / driver bridge.
Logitech G HUB UI process. Persistent overlay process with periodic device polling. Pause if you're not actively using G HUB macros / on-the-fly config.
G HUB background agent that talks to peripherals. Heavier than the UI process; safe to pause when no macros are in use.
Auto-update check process for G HUB. Pure background; no game depends on it being live.
GPU overclock + OSD. Default-disabled because users running an OC profile or watching the OSD will want it; flip on if your OC is set in BIOS/MSI Center and Afterburner is just sitting in tray.
Frame-limit + overlay backbone for Afterburner. Don't suspend if you rely on RTSS frame caps — that will release the cap mid-game.
Launcher background process. Heavier than Steam's; suspending while playing a different game is fine.
Launcher background. Same reasoning as GOG.
Embedded Chromium helper inside Epic Games Launcher. Pause with the main launcher.
Music streaming client. Default-disabled — most gamers want music during sessions. Enable only if you listen on another device.
Voice/chat. *Don't* suspend if you'll use Discord while gaming. Listed for users who alt-tab less.
Workplace chat. Heavy Electron app with background sync. Pause unless you need work notifications during the session.
Heavyweight Electron + Skype-stack. Suspending stops idle CPU draw; resume restores chat/meeting state. Pause for personal sessions; skip for on-call shifts.
WebView2-based Teams successor. Lighter than classic but still a real CPU draw at idle.
Electron messaging client. Background sync; resume lands queued messages.
Legacy Skype client. Mostly idle, but suspends cleanly.
Code's idle CPU is low, but extensions (LSP servers, linters) keep workers busy. Pause if your editor is just sitting open.
Background tabs / sync. Same reasoning as Edge / Chrome.
Edge keeps background helpers running for sync/PWA. Suspending pauses them; foreground tabs aren't affected if Edge isn't focused.
Same as Edge — Chrome's background tabs / extensions / sync can spike CPU.
Torrent client. Disk + network heavy. Pause for clean upload/download stop during gameplay.
Torrent client. Same reasoning as qBittorrent.
Voice chat. Don't suspend if you're in a TS channel for the game.
Open-source voice chat. Same reasoning as TS3.
Win10 Phone Link / Your Phone bridge. Periodic Bluetooth chatter; safe to pause.
Modern Phone Link host. Pair with CDPSvc pause for full Phone-Link quietude.
Auto-update process for OneDrive. Pure background; safe to pause.
Auto-updates Chrome / other Google apps. Periodic background check.

denylist.rationale: Microsoft Defender's main process. Suspending AV is the canonical malware tactic and breaks anti-cheat checks. Permanently denied.
Microsoft Defender Network Inspection Service. Suspending it is equivalent to suspending Defender — same anti-cheat / security reasoning. Permanently denied.
Windows Security UI host. Suspending breaks the Security Center notifications and can trip anti-cheat heuristics. Permanently denied.
The shell. Suspending it freezes the taskbar, start menu, and most input dialogs. Permanently denied.
Desktop Window Manager — the compositor. Suspending it freezes screen redraw and breaks fullscreen-exclusive transitions. Permanently denied.
Windows Audio Device Graph Isolation. Suspending it stops audio output mid-game. Permanently denied.
User-mode font driver host. Suspending it breaks text rendering across the system. Permanently denied.
User logon manager. Suspending it locks you out. Permanently denied.
Client/Server Runtime Subsystem. Suspending it blue-screens the machine. Permanently denied.
Local Security Authority. Same outcome as csrss. Permanently denied.
Service Control Manager. Permanently denied.
Session Manager. Permanently denied.
Windows Initialization. Permanently denied.
Shell Infrastructure Host. Backs Action Center, Start menu animations, and the shell's per-user UI. Suspending degrades shell responsiveness. Permanently denied.
UWP / Modern apps window frame host. Suspending freezes any open Store-app windows. Permanently denied.
UWP runtime broker. Suspending breaks UWP app permission negotiation and frequently crashes the affected apps. Permanently denied.
Windows lock-screen UWP app. Suspending breaks lock-screen show/hide transitions. Permanently denied.
Win11 Start menu host. Suspending freezes the Start menu and pinned-app search. Permanently denied.
Windows shell experience (Action Center, calendar flyout). Suspending breaks notifications. Permanently denied.
Touch / IME input host. Suspending breaks IME for languages that use it and can lose keyboard input entirely. Permanently denied.
Win11 search UI host. Suspending breaks the Start menu search box and Windows Search overlay. Permanently denied.
Cicero text-input host. Suspending breaks keyboard input switching and on-screen-keyboard interaction. Permanently denied.

NVIDIA Container — the umbrella process that hosts driver telemetry, GeForce Experience, and the Game Bar overlay path. Suspending breaks the in-game overlay, NVENC capture, and DLSS Frame Generation. Permanently denied.
NVIDIA display container host. Suspending breaks display switching and panel power management. Permanently denied.
AMD external events utility. Suspending can wedge HDR / dynamic-resolution toggles on Radeon drivers. Permanently denied.
AMD Adrenalin Software UI. Suspending breaks the in-game overlay and recording. Permanently denied.
